neighbours.label: The token ' mult' (the split prefix of multi- words such as multilateral, multistep, multicomponent); not ' multiple', ' multi' or ' multiply'
fire: The dispute was referred to a multilateral trade body in Geneva.
Extraction of the compound is a multistep procedure that takes two days.
The coating was modelled as a multicomponent mixture of oxides.
Several nations signed a multilateral agreement on fishing rights.
Those butterflies are multivoltine and breed several times a year.
The reaction proceeds through a multistep pathway with two intermediates.
Diplomats prefer multilateral talks to one-on-one meetings.
The engineers studied a multicomponent alloy of nickel and cobalt.
quiet: The dispute was referred to multiple trade bodies in Geneva.
Extraction of the compound is a long procedure that takes two days.
The coating was modelled as a multi-layer stack of oxides.
Several nations signed a joint agreement on fishing rights.
Those butterflies multiply quickly and breed several times a year.
The reaction proceeds through multiple steps with two intermediates.
Diplomats prefer many-sided talks to one-on-one meetings.
The engineers studied a complex alloy of nickel and cobalt.
